name: Your live sessions
description: Every session that could be used to act as you, so that one you do not recognise can be ended. It reads live_sessions rather than sessions: a revoked or expired row is not a way in, and listing it would only invite someone to revoke what is already dead. `current` marks the session asking -- the one row the page must not offer to end casually, since ending it is signing out and DELETE /v1/session is the door marked for that. user_agent is returned verbatim; naming the browser is the page's job.
